html:
Here is a photo of the moon of February 15, 2008.
Photo taken at the prime focus of the 8" LX90 with a Canon Rebel XTI DSLR.
Settings: 1 X 1/250 seconds exposure at ISO 800 at F/10, no dark, no flat.
Software: No processing
Site: Grand-Mère in Mauricie.
